title: Effective recovery of etale presented modules from their local cokernels
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with its Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site] and small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and put $\mathcal O_{T,\mathrm{et}}(v:V\to T)=\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$. Write $L_T=\epsilon_T^*$ for tensor pullback and $R_T=\epsilon_{T,*}$ for restriction to open subschemes along the canonical morphism of ringed sites $\epsilon_T:T_{\mathrm{et}}\to T_{\mathrm{Zar}}$ [lem-trf-zariski-etale-tensor-sections]. Modules mean sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]; Zariski quasi-coherence is [pqf-def-coherent] and site quasi-coherence is [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. Let $G$ be a site quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_{T,\mathrm{et}}$-module. Let $\{u_i:V_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ be a jointly surjective etale family with specified presentations $\mathcal O_{V_i,\mathrm{et}}^{(K_i)}\xrightarrow{d_i}\mathcal O_{V_i,\mathrm{et}}^{(J_i)}\to G|_{(V_i)_{\mathrm{et}}}\to0$. There exist unique maps $h_i:\mathcal O_{V_i}^{(K_i)}\to\mathcal O_{V_i}^{(J_i)}$ whose $L_{V_i}$-images are $d_i$ under the canonical free-module identifications. Their cokernels $F_i$ are Zariski quasi-coherent and carry isomorphisms $b_i:L_{V_i}F_i\simeq G|_{(V_i)_{\mathrm{et}}}$ compatible with the cokernel projections. On $V_{ij}=V_i\times_TV_j$, with projections $p_i,p_j$, the maps $b_j^{-1}b_i$ between the restrictions of these images lift uniquely to isomorphisms $\phi_{ij}:p_i^*F_i\simeq p_j^*F_j$, and on triple products $\phi_{jk}\phi_{ij}=\phi_{ik}$, with the canonical pullback identifications understood. This datum is effective: there are a Zariski quasi-coherent $F$ on $T$ and isomorphisms $u_i^*F\simeq F_i$ inducing $\phi_{ij}$, and the resulting local maps glue uniquely to $b:L_TF\simeq G$. Restriction of $b$ to opens identifies $F$ with $R_TG$. In particular $R_TG$ is quasi-coherent and the canonical counit $L_TR_TG\to G$ is an isomorphism whose map on every open subscheme is the identity under these identifications.

proof.text: The normalized global unit is objectwise an isomorphism: its composite with two isomorphisms on every open is the identity. Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app therefore makes the unit invertible. Compose its isomorphism with the restriction of the glued isomorphism to get a:F ≅ R_T G. Quasi-coherence transfers along a. The adjunction Hom equivalence gives L(a) followed by the canonical counit equal to the glued isomorphism, so the counit is invertible. Obtain normalized tensor coordinates for R_T G from lem-trf-etale-extension-free-presentations-hom; proof irrelevance identifies its context with c. Cancel the tensor/open comparisons in the unit equation and use the right triangle identity evaluated at each open to prove the specified counit_open equation. Assemble all fields of the original EtalePresentedRecovery structure, whose signature and fields are unchanged.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q149-7275c87fd (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read Stacks descent.tex 03DX (proposition-equivalence-quasi-coherent) in full, including its last sentence extending the proof to the small étale site; 023T through lem-pc-fpqc-descent(1); and 03EM through lem-pur-sheaf-hom-cover-gluing. The 8 steps follow the 03DX proof. Step 1: L preserves arbitrary small coproducts and sends O to O_et, so the free modules are identified. Step 2: Hom bijection gives h_i; F_i is quasi-coherent by cokernel closure; b_i comes from uniqueness of cokernels. Step 3: phi_ij is lifted on V_ij using pullback quasi-coherence and the étale restriction identification over V_i; its inverse is lifted too. Step 4: the cocycle that 03DX omits is written out, plus diagonal normalization (e^2=e). Step 5: fpqc effectivity with no quasi-compactness assumed on the u_i; the descent orientations match. Step 6: I checked c_j=c_i on overlaps; the 03EM gluing is done at the terminal object and again for the inverses. Step 7: a=R(b)eta_F, and the adjunct formula gives b=eps_G L(a), so the canonical counit is invertible. Step 8: the triangle identity gives eps_G(W)=1 on opens. Statement and stmt_deps are byte-identical to the Q106 re-split version; old parent steps 5-7 are fully carried. proof_deps equals the union of the step uses. No cycle (213-node closure reaches neither the item nor the parent). No new nodes; no duplicate in the DAG (03DX hits are the parent, its siblings, rank-one nodes and citers). No SGA cited. Edge cases checked: empty K_i/J_i, empty T, identity cover, non-separated overlaps, infinite non-quasi-compact families. Accepted the 7 generic off-unit tool_uses.

lean.statement: theorem etalePresentedModule_effectiveRecovery (c : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, ZariskiEtaleModuleContext X) (T : Scheme.{u}) (G : SmallEtaleModules T) [G.IsQuasicoherent] (I : Type w) (U : I → T.Etale) (cover : ∀ x : T, ∃ (i : I) (y : (U i).left), (U i).hom.base y = x) (K J : I → Type u) (d : ∀ i, SheafOfModules.free (R := smallEtaleModuleRing (U i).left) (K i) ⟶ SheafOfModules.free (J i)) (q : ∀ i, SheafOfModules.free (R := smallEtaleModuleRing (U i).left) (J i) ⟶ (presentedEtaleRestriction (U i)).obj G) (zero : ∀ i, d i ≫ q i = 0) (presentation : ∀ i, Nonempty (IsColimit (CokernelCofork.ofπ (q i) (zero i)))) : Nonempty (EtalePresentedRecovery c T G I U K J d q)
